name: product-led-eng-fleet
description: Run a product-led engineering fleet over a GitHub-issue work queue.

interface.shortDescription: PM/orchestrator loop + implementer sub-agents coordinated through a GitHub-issue queue.
interface.longDescription: A reusable operating model for running software delivery as a fleet of autonomous coding agents coordinated through a GitHub-issue work queue. The PM files self-contained, pickup-ready issues; an orchestrator loop triages a deterministically-ranked queue, claims issues, delegates to implementer sub-agents, monitors each PR, and merges; implementers each take one issue, build against its acceptance criteria, open a PR, and stop. The queue state — what's ready, what's ranked first, who actually has what — is computed by a deterministic git/gh engine rather than by agent reasoning.
capabilities: Deterministic GitHub-issue queue engine (ranked list, ground-truth, claim, release, status)
Orchestrator loop that delegates issues to implementer sub-agents and owns the review/merge cycle
Fleet conventions enforced as rules: acceptance-criteria-as-contract, Refs-not-Closes, agents stop at PR-open
interface.defaultPrompt: Run one iteration of the engineering fleet loop: triage the ready queue, claim and delegate the top issues, and report what you merged.
